title: Flash-Sale E-commerce Backend: Safe Stock, Fast Orders
summary: EN: Build an order and payment system for a high-traffic flash sale. | 中文: 构建一个支持浏览、购物车、下单和支付的高并发秒杀电商后端。
EN: Never oversell stock or charge the same order twice. | 中文: 最难的约束是库存不能卖超，而且同一订单不能重复扣款。
EN: Return orders quickly and recover every important state after failures. | 中文: 成功标准是快速返回订单，安全处理支付未知状态，并在失败后恢复订单、库存和支付记录。

sections.title: Understanding
points: This is a flash-sale platform for browsing products, managing carts, and placing orders.
Up to 100,000 users may buy limited stock at the same time.
The API must respond quickly, while payment may be slow, unavailable, or unknown.
Orders need status queries, safe retries, ten-minute expiry, stock release, and audit history.
Main risks are concurrent stock updates and payment recovery; assume durable database and provider status lookup.
speakingNotes: 中文理解：我先把题目拆成业务流程和风险。 | SAY: I will first break down the flow and risks.
中文理解：这是一个 Flash Sale 平台，用户先浏览商品，再加入 cart，最后提交 order。 | SAY: Users browse products, add carts, and place orders.
中文理解：高峰有 100,000 个用户抢有限库存，所以同一个 SKU 会产生强并发。 | SAY: Many users may buy the same SKU together.
中文理解：系统要快速返回订单，还要支持查询、十分钟过期、失败释放库存和 audit history。 | SAY: The order must be fast and auditable.
中文理解：Payment Provider 可能 timeout，timeout 不代表扣款一定失败，所以不能盲目重试。 | SAY: A payment timeout does not mean payment failed.
中文理解：最难的是并发库存和未知支付状态。我假设 durable database 保存核心状态，Provider 支持 status lookup。 | SAY: I assume the database and provider support recovery.

sections.title: Approach
points: Keep the synchronous path short: validate, reserve stock, and return a pending order.
Use PostgreSQL as the durable source of truth for orders, stock, and payment state.
Move payment, expiry, and recovery work to asynchronous workers.
Use Kafka and a transactional outbox to deliver durable background tasks.
Use idempotency, valid state changes, and backpressure for safe retries and traffic spikes.
speakingNotes: 中文理解：现在从 requirements 推导整体方案。我先把快速请求和慢任务分开。 | SAY: I will separate fast requests from slow work.
中文理解：API 只做校验、幂等检查和 stock reservation，然后马上返回 PENDING_PAYMENT。 | SAY: The API reserves stock and returns a pending order.
中文理解：订单、库存和 payment state 要放在 durable database 中，PostgreSQL 是 source of truth。 | SAY: PostgreSQL is the source of truth.
中文理解：支付和过期处理不阻塞 API，它们放到 Kafka 后面的 Worker。 | SAY: Workers handle payment and expiry asynchronously.
中文理解：Transactional outbox 把业务状态和待发送 event 一起保存，避免订单成功但消息丢失。 | SAY: I save the order and event together.
中文理解：Kafka 吸收 traffic spike，backpressure 限制系统继续接收；idempotency 让重复 retry 不产生新结果。 | SAY: Backpressure protects the system during traffic spikes.

sections.title: Core Solution
points: Use a client request ID and a unique constraint to return one order for duplicate requests.
Lock an available stock bucket with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and decrement only when stock remains.
Save the order, reservation, expiry time, audit event, and outbox event in one transaction.
Return order ID as PENDING_PAYMENT; a worker calls the provider with one stable idempotency key.
Use guarded state changes: successful payment consumes stock, while failure or expiry releases the reservation.
After timeout or crash, query provider status, reconcile unknown results, and serve durable status.
speakingNotes: 中文理解：这一页按一笔 order 的实际 data flow 来讲。 | SAY: I will now follow one order through the system.
中文理解：API 收到 client request ID；如果用户重复提交，unique constraint 会返回原来的 order。 | SAY: A unique request ID prevents duplicate orders.
中文理解：库存被分成多个 stock bucket。Transaction 用 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED 锁一个还有库存的 bucket，减少 hot SKU 冲突。 | SAY: We lock one available stock bucket.
中文理解：同一个 transaction 条件扣减库存，并写入 reservation、order、expiresAt、audit event 和 outbox event，避免只成功一部分。 | SAY: I save stock and order state together.
中文理解：写入成功后，API 立刻返回 orderId 和 PENDING_PAYMENT。用户不用等待外部 Provider。 | SAY: The API returns a pending order quickly.
中文理解：Payment Worker 使用固定 idempotency key。这个 key 让同一笔支付的 retry 不会再次扣款。 | SAY: The same key makes payment retries safe.
中文理解：Provider timeout 后先做 status query。服务 crash 后，Reconciliation Worker 继续处理 unknown state。 | SAY: We check the provider before retrying.
中文理解：Guarded state change 只允许合法状态转换。Status API 读取 durable state，让用户看到最新状态。 | SAY: The status API reads durable state.
sections.visual:
flowchart LR
  User[User] --> Gateway[API Gateway]
  Gateway --> Edge[Rate Limit + Admission Control]
  Gateway --> Read[Catalog and Status API]
  Read --> Cache[(Redis Cache)]
  Read --> DB[(PostgreSQL)]
  Edge --> API[Stateless Order API]
  API --> DB
  API --> Stock[Stock Service]
  Stock --> Buckets[(Stock Buckets)]
  API --> Outbox[Transactional Outbox]
  Outbox --> Kafka[Kafka Queue]
  Kafka --> Payment[Payment Worker]
  Payment --> Provider[Payment Provider]
  Payment -. timeout .-> Recon[Reconciliation Worker]
  Recon --> Provider
  Recon --> DB
  Kafka --> Expiry[Expiry Worker]
  Expiry --> DB
  Expiry --> Buckets

sections.title: Verification
points: Duplicate requests and Kafka redelivery must not create a second order or payment.
A payment timeout stays unknown until reconciliation; never send a blind new charge.
If the worker crashes after charging, provider lookup repairs the local payment state.
Payment and expiry races allow one state change; late success goes to refund review.
Admission control and backpressure protect the database when traffic or queue lag rises.
Load tests verify stock invariants; the trade-off is eventual payment status and more recovery work.
speakingNotes: 中文理解：现在主动检查这个设计在 production 里怎么失败。 | SAY: I will test the design against production failures.
中文理解：重复请求和 Kafka redelivery 都可能重复执行，所以要用 unique key 和 idempotency 防重。 | SAY: Idempotency prevents duplicate orders and payments.
中文理解：Provider timeout 后结果不确定。先做 reconciliation，确认状态前不能发送新的 charge。 | SAY: We check the provider before a new charge.
中文理解：Worker 可能在扣款后 crash。Reconciliation 查询 Provider，再安全补写本地 payment state。 | SAY: Recovery repairs the local payment state.
中文理解：payment 和 expire 可能同时发生。guarded transition 只允许一个结果，late success 进入 refund review。 | SAY: One valid state change wins the race.
中文理解：流量或 queue lag 太高时，Admission Control 和 backpressure 会减慢新请求，保护数据库。 | SAY: Backpressure protects the database under load.
中文理解：压测要抢同一个 SKU，并检查 available、reserved、sold 的总量不超过库存。主要代价是 payment eventual consistency。 | SAY: Tests verify stock safety and eventual payment status.

sections.title: Wrap-up
points: Recommend PostgreSQL transactions, stock buckets, Kafka outbox, and idempotent provider calls.
This protects stock and duplicate charges while keeping the order API fast and recoverable.
The trade-off is eventual payment status and more operational work for reconciliation and monitoring.
speakingNotes: 中文理解：最后总结推荐方案，不再引入新的大型组件。 | SAY: I will summarize the recommended design.
中文理解：PostgreSQL transaction 保护库存和订单，Kafka 与 Worker 处理慢的 payment。 | SAY: Transactions protect stock, and workers handle payment.
中文理解：idempotency 和 reconciliation 让 retry、timeout 和 crash 更安全。 | SAY: Idempotency and reconciliation make recovery safer.
中文理解：主要代价是 payment status 可能最终一致，系统也需要更多监控和运维。 | SAY: The main trade-off is eventual payment status.
